## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to bound an availability statement to the [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) it covers — the free-busy slot whose start/end carry the dateTime endpoints.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting two slots (it is functional — one interval per availability) and avoid putting raw dateTimes here; the slot is an interval object whose bounds hold the [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime) values (P3).

### How to use

- Point the availability at one [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) whose bounds and [`gmeow:hasTemporalFrame`](gmeow-hasTemporalFrame.md) carry the timing; the status applies uniformly across that whole slot.

### Examples

- ex:lillithBusy [`gmeow:availabilitySlot`](gmeow-availabilitySlot.md) ex:morningSlot.
